response.justification: Highly experienced full-stack engineer with well over the required 6 years, including recent, directly relevant work in TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes, plus current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure work (MCP code generators and agentic frameworks) that maps precisely to a stated requirement. Deep testing culture is a standout — TDD/pairing/CI practice, authored a D test runner and assertion library, and taught Selenium/testing courses. Gaps are mostly framework-specific (no explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or PostgreSQL) and the polyglot profile leans heavily on DLang rather than Kotlin/Java, but these are easily bridgeable given the demonstrated architecture and multi-language breadth. Strong candidate to advance.
strengths: Recent, hands-on AI-agent/MCP tooling experience — a rare, explicitly required skill
Deep full-stack track record in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes
Exceptional testing and craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, authored test tooling, teaches workshops)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest, or Jest experience listed in the primary stack
Kotlin/Java exposure is limited and dated; polyglot depth skews toward niche DLang
Relational DB experience (PostgreSQL) is thin; recent data work is mostly MongoDB

key_factors.factor: Core TypeScript/Node/React full-stack depth and seniority
